Container.Name: TrackSeerr-Core
Container.Overview:
TrackSeerr Core: the internal half of the two-tier setup. Pair with TrackSeerr Requests, the public request portal. Works with Plex, Jellyfin, Subsonic servers (Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic), or no media server.
Core holds your database, media server credentials, Last.fm keys, download clients, indexers and media library. Admins use its WebUI on the LAN. Never expose this container's port to the internet; point your reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel at TrackSeerr Requests instead. Requests signs every call to Core with INTERNAL_CORE_SECRET and can only perform requester actions, never admin ones.
Set APPLICATION_URL to the PUBLIC URL of TrackSeerr Requests (e.g. https://requests.yourdomain.com).
Keep this container's name as TrackSeerr-Core (Docker DNS resolves containers by name, and Requests defaults to http://TrackSeerr-Core:5251).
Unraid publishes the admin port on all host interfaces. Never forward this port on your router; restrict it to your LAN or VPN with your firewall. Set LAN Bind IP to the LAN IP you use.
Network setup (one time): 1. In the Unraid terminal run: docker network create --internal trackseerr-internal docker network create trackseerr-core-lan 2. Leave Network Type on Bridge (so Unraid still publishes the admin port) and in Extra Parameters (Advanced view) add: --network=trackseerr-core-lan --network=trackseerr-internal Unraid ignores the Network Type dropdown once Extra Parameters contain a --network flag, so both networks must be listed here. Never add your reverse-proxy/cloudflared network to Core. Needs Docker 25+ (Unraid 7); on older versions leave Extra Parameters empty and after each start run: docker network connect trackseerr-internal TrackSeerr-Core 3. Use the same INTERNAL_CORE_SECRET on TrackSeerr Requests (generate with: openssl rand -hex 32). The internal network name is your choice; keep it identical on both containers. Reach Plex and downloaders by LAN IP.
Migrating from all-in-one: edit your existing TrackSeerr container, set ROLE to core, add INTERNAL_CORE_SECRET and set APPLICATION_URL, then apply. Or install this template pointing at the same appdata path. No data migration is needed. Users sign in once more on TrackSeerr Requests. The Plex webhook URL is unchanged.

Config.Name: Core Admin Port
Config.Description: LAN admin WebUI, API and Plex webhook port. Keep this on your LAN; never forward it to the internet.

Config.Name: LAN Bind IP
Config.Description: The LAN IP the admin port is published on (e.g. 192.168.1.10); informational, used to suppress the exposure warning.

Config.Name: Listen Port
Config.Description: DO NOT CHANGE. Internal listen port for Core (must match the Core Admin Port target and the Requests Core URL).

Config.Name: Application URL
Config.Description: PUBLIC URL of TrackSeerr Requests (e.g. https://requests.yourdomain.com), NOT this container. Used for notification links and Plex OAuth redirects.

Config.Name: AppData Storage
Config.Description: Persistent configuration directory for the SQLite database, sessions, and logs.

Config.Name: Data Storage (TRaSH Guides)
Config.Description: Unified host data share containing both library (/data/media/music) and download staging (/data/downloads) on a single filesystem to enable instant atomic moves and hardlinks.

Config.Name: Execution Role
Config.Description: DO NOT CHANGE. This template must run as ROLE=core.

Config.Name: Internal Core Secret
Config.Description: REQUIRED. 32+ characters, identical on TrackSeerr Requests. Signs gateway-to-core requests. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Media Server
Config.Description: plex, jellyfin, subsonic or none. Leave empty to use Plex when Plex URL and token are set, or to choose in Settings > Media Management > Media Server.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Creates the first local admin (user 'admin') when there is no Plex server to sign in with. At least 12 characters. Only used on first start.

Config.Name: Plex Server URL
Config.Description: Plex only. Set together with Plex Token, or leave both empty. Use the LAN IP, not localhost.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex only. Set together with Plex Server URL, or leave both empty.

Config.Name: Plex Music Library Section
Config.Description: Name of the Plex music library to use. Leave empty to use the first music library.

Config.Name: Plex Machine Identifier
Config.Description: Plex server machine identifier for multi-user access pinning. Leave blank to auto-detect.

Config.Name: Plex SSL Verification
Config.Description: Set to 0 if your Plex Media Server uses a self-signed certificate without valid chain.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Server URL
Config.Description: Jellyfin base URL. Requires MEDIA_SERVER=jellyfin. Can be configured in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API Key
Config.Description: Jellyfin API key. Requires MEDIA_SERVER=jellyfin. Can be configured in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Subsonic Server URL
Config.Description: Subsonic base URL. Requires MEDIA_SERVER=subsonic. Can be configured in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Subsonic Username
Config.Description: Subsonic username. Requires MEDIA_SERVER=subsonic. Can be configured in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Subsonic Password
Config.Description: Subsonic password. Requires MEDIA_SERVER=subsonic. Can be configured in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Feed Access Token
Config.Description: Optional: Secret token to protect RSS feeds, plain text lists, and webhook endpoints if exposed to untrusted networks.

Config.Name: Sync Interval (Seconds)
Config.Description: Duration in seconds between automated background sync cycles (default 14400 = 4 hours).

Config.Name: User ID (PUID)
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user ID for file permission compatibility.

Config.Name: Group ID (PGID)
Config.Description: Unraid users group ID for file permission compatibility.

Config.Name: Umask
Config.Description: Standard umask permissions for created files.
